exifAnchor.claim: settings anchor only; not a Galaxy M01 reproduction

model.lensIrradiance: on-axis thin-lens E_lambda = L_lambda * pi / (4*N^2) * transmission
model.spectralResponse: PBRT Canon 5D Mark IV relative response shapes globally normalized and reinterpreted only as authored generic Bayer QE shapes
model.photonConversion: photons = E_lambda * pixelArea * shutter * integral_bin(lambda/(h*c) * QE_c(lambda) d lambda)
model.rawClipping: electrons_captured = min(photoelectrons, fullWellElectrons), before characterization, white balance, ISO metadata, ADC, or sRGB
model.noise: recorded but disabled for the deterministic saturation proof
model.iso: recorded setting; 1.02 nominal gain applied only to normalized post-well ADC signal and cannot undo full-well clipping
model.development: fixed D55 characterization to D65 XYZ, linear Rec.709 conversion, hard display clamp, IEC sRGB encoding; no tone curve

references.use: QE, electron saturation capacity, and noise are separate sensor quantities
small-pixel simulated full-well examples from 1289 to 6390 electrons
published physical-camera simulation precedent with 2.2 micrometer pixels and 9000-electron well

claimLimit: EXIF-anchored generic-phone concept proof. Authored sensor parameters and PBRT-derived QE shapes prohibit a Galaxy M01 or other named-device reproduction claim.
